def analyze(p):
    i=G[p+' input']; o=G[p+' output']
    H,W=len(i),len(i[0])
    sepval=next(x for x in range(1,10) if any(all(i[r][c]==x and x!=0 for r in range(H) if False) for _ in [0])) 
    rowsS=[r for r in range(H) if len(set(i[r]))==1 and i[r][0]!=0]
    sepval=i[rowsS[0]][0]
    colsS=[c for c in range(W) if all(i[r][c]==sepval for r in range(H))]
    rb=[];prev=-1
    for x in rowsS+[H]:
        if x>prev+1: rb.append((prev+1,x-1))
        prev=x
    cb=[];prev=-1
    for x in colsS+[W]:
        if x>prev+1: cb.append((prev+1,x-1))
        prev=x
    print(p,'rb',rb,'cb',cb)
    for a,b in rb:
        print('band rows',a,b)
        for rr in range(a,b+1):
            line=[]
            for c,d in cb:
                blk=' '.join(str(x) for x in o[rr][c:d+1])
                line.append(blk[:6])
            print(' ',line)
analyze('Demo pair 1')
print('===')
analyze('Demo pair 2')

def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    rseps=[r for r in range(H) if len(set(g[r]))==1 and g[r][0]!=0]
    cseps=[c for c in range(W) if all(g[r][c]==g[0][c] for r in range(H)) and g[0][c]!=0]
    def bands(seps,n):
        bs=[];prev=-1
        for x in seps+[n]:
            if x>prev+1: bs.append((prev+1,x-1)); prev=x
        return bs
    rb=bands(rseps,H); cb=bands(cseps,W)
    # source block: first (top-left-most) block with nonzero content
    src=None
    for a,b in rb:
        for ca,e in cb:
            if any(g[i][j]!=0 for i in range(a,b+1) for j in range(ca,e+1)):
                src=(a,b,ca,e)
                break
        if src: break
    a,b,ca,e=src
    pat=sorted((i-a,j-ca) for i in range(a,b+1) for j in range(ca,e+1) if g[i][j]!=0)
    colors=[g[i][j] for i in range(a,b+1) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]!=0]
    color=Counter(colors).most_common(1)[0][0]
